game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must hold off icicle bats while practicing functions. Core idea – Scope Sanctuary: Distinguish local from global variables to keep snowshoes safe from icicle bats.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Distinguish local from global variables to keep snowshoes safe from icicle bats. Then check scope_safe and advance.
player_objective: Protect the larder door from icicle bats in Frozen Well: keep scope_safe above zero until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Scope Sanctuary
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 6, Level 7, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.

region.name: Snowy Hold
region.mood: soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

learning_objectives: Apply “Scope Sanctuary” in a short challenge

Press SPACE to run a code fix when the meter drops.
Survive for 67 seconds to complete the level.
